body: ## Purpose
What happens when a Free workspace uses up its monthly included usage.
## Limits
- Free includes a fixed monthly amount of billed tokens and requests.
- Free has no overage: nothing beyond the included usage is ever charged, and Free workspaces never get an invoice.
## At the limit
Once a Free workspace reaches its monthly limit, further requests are rate-limited: the API returns HTTP `429` with error code `quota_exceeded` and a `Retry-After` header. Requests work again when the next month starts. To keep sending requests sooner, the customer upgrades to a paid plan.
_Last reviewed 2025-11-10._"}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "10/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "## Dedicated usage: credits and discounts
- Discounts for Dedicated should generally be expressed as changes to **commit level** or **unit price for burst usage** (if burst is enabled).
- Credits may be applied to burst usage invoices or as an invoice-level service credit.
- Credits should not be used to effectively reduce a committed minimum without Finance approval; that changes contract economics and RevRec.
## Stacking rules
- Default: **one commercial discount** (unit price override or percent discount) may be active per meter at a time.
- Promotional credits may coexist with negotiated unit pricing.
- Additional stacking (e.g., unit price override + invoice percent discount + marketing credits) requires an exception approval."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "4/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "## Policy summary (non-negotiables)
1. **All discounting and credits must be recorded in systems of record** (Deal/Account + Billing) and have an approver trail.
2. **No retroactive price changes** to already-invoiced usage without Finance + Legal approval and a documented RevRec assessment.
3. **Credits apply to billed usage as computed by billing meters** (not customer-estimated counts).
4. **Discount stacking is limited** (see “Stacking rules”). Any exception is an exception request.
5. Credits must have an **expiry date** unless explicitly waived by Finance (rare; requires CFO approval).
6. Any term that could be interpreted as “free usage” must include a clear definition of **the exact meter(s)** and the application order (see “Contract language requirements”)."}]}
